content: प्रवृत्तिः {%f.%} .²1 Continued advance. .²2 Rise, origin, source, flow (of words <ab>&c.</ab>); प्रवृत्तिरासीच्छब्दानां चरितार्था चतुष्टयी <ls>Ku. 2. 17</ls>. .²3 Appearance, manifestation; कुसुमप्रवृत्तिसमये <ls>Ś. 4. 9</ls>. (<ab>v. l.</ab>); <ls>R. 11. 43</ls>, <ls n="R.">14. 39</ls>, <ls n="R.">15. 4</ls>. .²4 Advent, setting in, commencement; आकालिकीं वीक्ष्य मधुप्रवृत्तिम् <ls>Ku. 3. 34</ls>. .²5 Application or addiction to, tendency, inclination, predilection, propensity; न हि प्रजानामि तव प्रवृत्तिम् <ls>Bg. 11. 31</ls>; सतां हि संदेहपदेषु वस्तुषु प्रमाणमन्तःकरणप्रवृत्तयः <ls>Ś. 1. 22</ls>. .²6 Conduct, behaviour; त्वां प्रत्यकस्मात् कलुषप्रवृत्तौ <ls>R. 14. 73</ls>. .²7 Employment, occupation, activity; विदितं वो यथा स्वार्था न मे काश्चित् प्रवृत्तयः <ls>Ku. 6. 26</ls>. .²8 Use, employment, currency (as of a word). .²9 Continued effort, perseverance. .²10 Signification, sense, acceptation (of a word). .²11 Continuance, permanence, prevalence. .²12 Active life, taking an active part in worldly affairs (<ab>opp.</ab> निवृत्ति); प्रवृत्तिः कुत्र कर्तव्या जीवितव्यं कथं नु वा <ls>H.</ls> .²13 News, tidings, intelligence; ततः प्रवृत्तिः सीतायाः <ls>Mb. 3. 148. 5</ls>; प्रवृत्तिसाराः खलु मादृशां गिरः <ls>Ki. 1. 25</ls>; जीमूतेन स्वकुशलमयीं हारयिष्यन् प्रवृत्तिम् <ls>Me. 4</ls>; <ls>V. 4. 20</ls>. .²14 Applicability or validity of a rule. .²15 Fate, destiny, luck. .²16 Cognition, direct perception or apprehension. .²17 Rutting juice, or ichor exuding from the temples of an elephant in rut. .²18 <ab>N.</ab> of the city of उज्जयिनी <ab>q. v.</ab> .²19 (In <ab>Arith.</ab>) The multiplier.
